selected_evidence.requirement: Script exists, executable, and produces correct output
selected_evidence.summary: Initial inspection found the script file was malformed (contained leftover heredoc/chmod text); rewrote it to a valid #!/bin/sh script and set mode 0755, root:root ownership.

selected_evidence.requirement: Cron entry scheduled for 02:15 daily invoking the script and redirecting output to the log
selected_evidence.summary: root's crontab now contains '15 2 * * * /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance >> /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>&1' alongside the default Alpine periodic entries.

selected_evidence.requirement: Cron daemon active so the schedule actually runs
selected_evidence.summary: crond was stopped; added it to the default runlevel and started it (status: started).

selected_evidence.requirement: Log file captures script output correctly
selected_evidence.summary: Manual invocation of the crontab command line appended 'inventory maintenance completed at <timestamp>' to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log.

selected_evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline (boot identity, crond, cron entry)
selected_evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id c3c51c23-a43c-44fb-858d-6e1fc3e9270b, crond status started, and cron entry present before restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: Restart acknowledgement returns before disconnection; node restarted one at a time
selected_evidence.summary: Issued 'nohup sh -c sleep 2; reboot' in background so the exec call returned its acknowledgement (pid 3049) before the node dropped connectivity.

selected_evidence.requirement: Proof of changed boot identity after restart
selected_evidence.summary: After reconnecting, boot_id read 7e6cd366-5deb-49b0-b9a3-acf6e1b326a5, differing from the pre-restart baseline, proving an actual reboot occurred (not just a service restart).

selected_evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of cron service, cron entry, script, and log data
selected_evidence.summary: After restart: crond status started, crontab still contains the 02:15 inventory-maintenance entry, script remains executable, and the log file retained its pre-restart entry plus a new entry from a fresh manual run, confirming persistence and continued function.
